intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Salinas for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the start of Santa photos at Northridge Mall) through December 24 (the last day of those photos), with the Salinas Holiday Parade of Lights (November 29), Breakfast with Santa at Sherwood Hall (December 5), Christmas in Closter Park (December 12 and 13) and Country Christmas at the Salinas Sports Complex (December 17) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Salinas

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Salinas
  • 5 free events, including the Salinas Holiday Parade of Lights, Winter Wonderland at the Salinas Family YMCA, Christmas in Closter Park, Country Christmas and the Soledad Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa at Sherwood Hall ($15 per person, December 5), Santa photos at Northridge Mall (November 27 to December 24), Cowboy Santa at Country Christmas (December 17) and Santa at the Tree for Peace lighting (November 28)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Tree for Peace Lighting Ceremony (November 28), the Salinas Holiday Parade of Lights (November 29) and Soledad's tree lighting and 40th Christmas Parade (December 4 and 5)
  • Toy giveaways and crafts: Christmas in Closter Park (December 12 and 13) with real snow, and Country Christmas with gifts for ages 2 to 12 (December 17)
  • Season: November 27 to December 24

Planning a bigger day out? Salinas families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids on the Monterey Peninsula, which covers Cannery Row, Fisherman's Wharf and holiday lights nearby.
